title: Tannenberg 1914: The Russian Army Swallowed by Unencrypted Radio
summary: Tells how, of the two Russian armies that entered East Prussia in August nineteen fourteen, Samsonov's Second Army was encircled and destroyed by the Germans at Tannenberg because it broadcast its orders by unencrypted radio. The episode reaches on to the rise of Hindenburg, called back from retirement, and Ludendorff, to Samsonov's suicide in the forest, to the effect at the Marne of the corps shifted from the West, and to the victory turning into a political legend.
